name: General contractors

problems.words: Cement and steel go missing from site every month
quick_ideas: Make one storekeeper the only person who signs for deliveries, so receiving has a single owner
Count cement bags and sariya once this week against the register, to see the real gap.

workzap_build.text: A site material register on phone with a photo of every delivery challan, issues to work and a running balance per site, with gaps flagged daily as patterns, not accusations.

problems.ask_first: Who signs for material when it reaches site?
problems.free_stops: The receiving flow and variance checks are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare this week's cement and steel issues with visible work completed on one site walk, so unusual usage shows early.
Keep one lockup issue notebook with one store hand responsible for every outflow note, so missing material has a trail.

problems.words: Material is ordered for the wrong site, then lorries shuttle it around
quick_ideas: Note every site-to-site move with who sent and who received, so nothing vanishes in between
Put the site name on every purchase request.

workzap_build.text: An inter-site transfer log where both ends confirm, flagging anything sent but not received across all sites.

problems.ask_first: How many sites are running right now?
problems.free_stops: Confirmation rules and alert timing are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many lorry trips moved materials between sites this week, so wrong ordering shows up in wasted movement.
Give one dispatcher one notebook page for all site transfer notes, so sending and receiving stop getting mixed up.

problems.words: I don't know actual material consumed against the BOQ
quick_ideas: Pick the top few BOQ items and compare issued quantity to work done once, to find the biggest leak
Review that comparison with the site engineer.

workzap_build.text: A BOQ against actual tracker per item and per site, with variance alerts as material is issued.

problems.ask_first: Which cost runs over most often: material, labour or machinery?
problems.free_stops: How consumption is measured against BOQ items is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare issued quantities for one BOQ item with the area or length completed on site, so heavy consumption stands out.
Give one site engineer a fixed weekly time to note issue versus work done for key items, so overruns surface sooner.

problems.words: We did extra work on verbal instructions and the client won't pay
quick_ideas: Get a written WhatsApp or email confirmation before any extra work starts, so there's a record
List all current unbilled extras with dates and photos; for disputes, take professional advice.

workzap_build.text: A variation register with request, photos, client approval, quantity and billing status, so nothing reaches the running bill unrecorded.

problems.ask_first: Who signs off extra work before it starts?
problems.free_stops: The approval steps and link to billing are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count extra tasks done on verbal instruction this week that have no dated site note, so unrecorded variation work is sized clearly.
Give one supervisor one site notebook for all extra work notes each day, so variation records stop getting missed.

problems.words: Running bills get certified late and retention is stuck for years
quick_ideas: List every unpaid bill and retention by project with its date, so the full amount owed is visible
Give one person ownership of chasing certification.

workzap_build.text: A running bill ledger with certification status and ageing of unpaid bills and retentions, with reminders on schedule.

problems.ask_first: How long do bills usually take to get certified and paid?
problems.free_stops: Ageing stages and follow-up rules are in the solution document; contract claims need professional advice.

extra_ideas.text: Compare recent running bill submission dates with certification dates by project, so the slowest internal follow-up points are clear.
Set one fixed weekly review for one person to note pending certifications and retentions, so follow-up stays on a routine.

problems.words: Thekedar shows fifty workers on the sheet, I count far fewer on site
quick_ideas: Do an unannounced headcount per gang once, to compare against the sheet
Ask the site in-charge, not the thekedar, to sign daily attendance.

workzap_build.text: Gang-wise attendance with a photo or location check-in on site, comparing headcount to what each thekedar claims every day, without storing ID details.

problems.ask_first: Is your labour direct, through thekedars, or both?
problems.free_stops: The check-in method and comparison report are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Do one midday headcount by gang and compare it with the attendance sheet, so over-reported labour becomes visible.
Make the site in-charge keep the only attendance sheet at one fixed spot, so labour counts stop changing later.

quick_ideas: Share each gang's attendance total before payday, so disagreements come up early
Write the overtime rule down once, so it's the same for everyone.

workzap_build.text: A dihari and wage calculator from daily attendance and overtime, producing a payslip per gang each pay cycle; labour-law questions go to a professional.

problems.free_stops: Wage rules and payslip layout are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare each gang's attendance total with the site attendance record before payday, so mismatches are spotted while the week is fresh.
Give one supervisor a fixed weekly time to close each gang's attendance totals, so attendance records stop changing late.

problems.words: Purchase requests from site wait days for office approval
quick_ideas: Set a small-spend limit the site in-charge can approve, so urgent items move
Batch other requests into one daily approval slot.

workzap_build.text: A purchase request flow from site to office with limits, phone approvals and a purchase order created straight away.

problems.ask_first: Who approves purchases from site today?
problems.free_stops: Approval limits and the PO flow are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note when each site purchase request reached office and when it was cleared this week, so approval waiting time is visible.
Set one daily time for one approver to clear pending site requests together, so office approvals stop stretching across days.

problems.words: Daily progress comes in WhatsApp voice notes from each site
quick_ideas: Ask each site for the same five-point update daily, so reports can be compared
Ask for a couple of dated photos with it.

workzap_build.text: A daily site report form (manpower, work done, material, issues, photos) that would roll up into one owner view across all sites and also build the site diary.

problems.ask_first: What do you wish you could see without calling site?
problems.free_stops: The report fields and report screen design are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare how many daily voice updates arrived from each site this week, so silent sites and late reporting stand out.
Give one coordinator a fixed evening time to collect all site progress notes in one place, so follow-up gets simpler.

problems.words: Rented machinery sits idle and we still pay for it
quick_ideas: List all rented plant with site and rent start date, so idle items stand out
Ask sites to mark idle days, so returns happen sooner.

workzap_build.text: A plant and machinery log with hours used, idle days, rental charges and service due dates for every machine.

problems.ask_first: Which machinery do you own and which do you rent?
problems.free_stops: How usage is recorded and costed is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each rented machine that did no work yesterday during your site calls, so paid idle time across projects is clear.
Make one office person keep a single return list for idle rented machines, so off-hire calls stop getting missed.

problems.words: Project finishes and I can't tell if we made money
quick_ideas: For one finished project, put billed, collected and cost in one sheet, to see the real result
Agree to track the same three numbers on the next project from day one.

workzap_build.text: A project P&L per site on nori, pulling bills, collections, material, labour and plant together and updating daily.

problems.ask_first: How do you compare actual spend to plan today?
problems.free_stops: Cost allocation rules and setup order are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare one finished project's final bill total with all supplier, labour and rent outflows noted in your file, so margin guesswork drops.
Give one person one notebook page per project for every cost note during the job, so the closing total is ready.

never_say: Any structural, scaffolding, excavation, lifting, electrical or fire-safety advice; a qualified engineer or safety officer decides.
Anything on contract claims, liquidated damages, bonds or labour law; suggest professional advice.
Any help faking attendance, inflating measurements, backdating site diaries, under-invoicing or paying for approvals.
Any request to record workers' names, CNIC/Emirates ID, passport or visa details, or wage bank details.
Anything other than emergency services first for a site accident, collapse, fall, electrocution or heatstroke.

sample_reply.person: Site pe cement aur sariya ka hisaab hi nahi milta, mahine ke end pe pata chalta hai material kahan gaya. Kuch hal batao.
sample_reply.pi:
Zaroor, ye sambhal sakta hai, aur pehla qadam aasan hai.
Pehle, delivery pe sign karne ka haq sirf ek storekeeper ko dein, taake receiving ka ek hi zimmedar ho.
Doosra, is hafte ek baar cement ki bori aur sariya gin ke register se milayen, taake asal farq saamne aaye.
Is mein Workzap ye shamil kar sakta hai: har delivery challan ki photo, har site ka roz ka material balance, aur farq aate hi alert.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
